concerns.text: T008 is declared 'parallel with T004–T007' (depending only on T002), but its acceptance criterion consumes ξ produced by T004: 'decay lengths within 20% of ξ (SC-004)'. ξ comes from data/processed/scaling_fits.json, which T004 writes. This is a hidden consumer-before-producer dependency: T008's verification cannot run until T004 completes. Either state T008 depends on T004 for its SC-004 check, or split T008 into a plotting task (T002-dependent) and a decay-length-vs-ξ validation step after T004.
